name: ebk_list
description: List the OS ids and images supported by ephemeral-build-kit (ebk). Use this to discover a valid --os id before running ebk_generate or ebk_run.

name: ebk_probe
description: Verify the host: Docker daemon, /dev/kvm and /dev/net/tun availability. Run this before starting any VM to confirm the environment is ready.

name: ebk_generate
description: Generate a docker-compose.yml for an OS without running the VM. Host ports are auto-shifted (后延) to the next free port if the requested one is occupied.

os.description: Operating system id, e.g. win10, win11, ubuntu, arch. Use ebk_list to see options.

runId.description: Run id used in container/compose/storage names. Auto-generated if omitted.

testDir.description: Host dir mounted as the shared/test folder (/shared or Z:).

packageDir.description: Host dir mounted as the package/oem folder.

debug.description: Enable verbose DEBUG/TRACE in the guest and print the compose file.

webPort.description: Host port for the 8006 web viewer. Default 8006.

vncPort.description: Host port for the native 5900 VNC server. Default 5900.

name: ebk_run
description: Full CI-style pipeline: generate -> docker compose up -> wait -> run tests -> capture screenshots/video -> collect artifacts -> cleanup. Runs a disposable VM and reports success/failure.

os.description: Operating system id, e.g. win10, ubuntu, arch. Required.

runId.description: Run id used in names/paths. Auto-generated if omitted.

testDir.description: Host dir mounted as the shared/test folder; the kit watches it for a RESULT_<runId>.* marker.

packageDir.description: Host dir mounted as the package/oem folder.

debug.description: Enable verbose DEBUG/TRACE in the guest.

webPort.description: Host port for the 8006 web viewer. Default 8006.

vncPort.description: Host port for the native 5900 VNC server. Default 5900.

testTimeout.description: Max minutes to wait for a test result marker. Default 20.

waitTimeout.description: Max minutes to wait for install readiness. Default 30.

bootSettle.description: Fallback settle time in seconds after the viewer is up. Default 0.

keep.description: Keep the container, compose file and storage after the run.

name: ebk_browser_up
description: Start a disposable Selenium Chrome container (Chrome + WebDriver + XFCE desktop + VNC + noVNC) and keep it running for browser-driven work. Prints the WebDriver / noVNC / VNC endpoints.

runId.description: Run id used in names/paths. Auto-generated if omitted.

browserImage.description: Use a prebuilt image tag instead of building.

seleniumPort.description: Host port for Selenium WebDriver. Default 4444.

shmSize.description: Shared memory size for the container. Default 2gb.

keep.description: Keep the container, compose and state after stopping.

name: ebk_browser_run
description: Full browser pipeline: start a Selenium Chrome container -> wait for WebDriver/noVNC -> capture screenshots/video (and optionally wait for a RESULT_<runId>.* marker) -> collect logs -> cleanup.

runId.description: Run id used in names/paths. Auto-generated if omitted.

testDir.description: Host dir that receives a RESULT_<runId>.* marker.

browserImage.description: Use a prebuilt image tag instead of building.

seleniumPort.description: Host port for Selenium WebDriver. Default 4444.

shmSize.description: Shared memory size for the container. Default 2gb.

duration.description: Capture duration in seconds when no --test-dir. Default 60.

testTimeout.description: Max minutes to wait for a result marker. Default 20.

keep.description: Keep the container, compose and state after stopping.

name: ebk_browser_status
description: Report whether the disposable browser container is running and show its WebDriver / noVNC / VNC endpoints.

name: ebk_browser_down
description: Stop and remove the disposable browser container started with ebk_browser_up, plus its compose dir, storage dir and state file.

keep.description: Keep the container, compose and state after stopping.
